author.name: Samuel Jacob
intro: I am a Tamilian, husband, and father of two, born and raised in Tamil Nadu and currently working as a software engineer in Silicon Valley—the place where I was born again.
My faith is grounded in biblical, historical Christianity, as summarized in the Apostles’ and Nicene Creeds.
author.contactText: You can email me about any of these books

books.title: Against The Drift
books.subtitle: Fact, fiction and the Hindu claims against the Cross
books.description: This book shows how historical and archaeological discoveries support the undeniable reliability of both the Old and New Testaments. And Why the transmission of the Bible is an 'anti-fragile' miracle, rather than a corrupted 'game of telephone'. It also provides a clear overview of core biblical doctrines designed to equip new believers with enduring truths.
